settings.heading: Who is Orenda Clean® for?
settings.row_content:
Orenda Clean® was formulated for health-conscious adults who want to support their liver function, antioxidant defenses, and digestive comfort as part of a consistent daily routine, not as a short-term cleanse or temporary program.

The formula is particularly well suited for those who want daily antioxidant support from a broad and research-backed botanical blend,* those looking for liver support ingredients like milk thistle, artichoke leaf, and calcium d-glucarate in one daily formula,* adults who experience occasional digestive discomfort and want gentle, consistent support from botanicals like serrapeptase, aloe vera, peppermint, and fennel,* and those who want adaptogenic stress support from ashwagandha and rhodiola as part of their daily wellness routine.*

What sets Orenda Clean® apart is the breadth of the formula — 18 botanicals and nutrients working across four distinct benefit areas in one daily scoop. Most liver and cleansing supplements address one or two of those areas. Orenda Clean® was built to address all four simultaneously.*

One scoop mixed with water daily. It fits into any routine without disrupting it, which is exactly how daily foundational support is meant to work.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of systemic serrapeptidase on Orenda Clean®?
settings.row_content:
Serrapeptase is a proteolytic enzyme with over 50 years of use and an established body of research in international clinical literature. Unlike digestive enzymes that work primarily in the gastrointestinal tract, serrapeptase is a systemic enzyme, meaning it is absorbed into the bloodstream and supports the body as a whole rather than working only in the digestive tract.*

In Orenda Clean®, serrapeptase supports the body's natural metabolic waste disposal processes* and contributes to a healthy inflammation response.* These are two of the most important functions in any daily cleansing formula, and two areas where most botanical cleansing supplements offer no support at all.

The systemic nature of serrapeptase is what makes it genuinely unusual among cleansing supplements. It works beyond digestion, supporting the body's natural cleansing processes from the inside out.* For a formula designed around daily liver and cleansing support, this is one of the ingredients that sets Orenda Clean® apart from standard options on the market.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of calcium d-glucarate in Orenda Clean®?
settings.row_content:
Calcium d-glucarate is one of the more specific and well-researched ingredients in the liver-support supplement space, and one that most botanical cleansing supplements don't include. Orenda Clean® uses Potassium Hydrogen Glucarate, the water-soluble form of calcium d-glucarate, which supports absorption and bioavailability.*

Here's why it matters. The body has a natural liver pathway called glucuronidation, which identifies metabolic waste and unwanted compounds and converts them into water-soluble forms that can be eliminated.* Calcium d-glucarate supports this process,* contributing to the liver's natural ability to process and clear what the body no longer needs.*

For a daily cleansing formula focused on supporting the body's natural cleansing processes, calcium d-glucarate addresses one of the most important yet least understood liver pathways, making it a key reason Orenda Clean® goes beyond a standard cleansing supplement.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of turmeric extract in Orenda Clean®?
settings.row_content:
Turmeric has one of the most extensive research profiles of any botanical ingredient, with thousands of published studies examining its active compounds and their effects on human health. The turmeric extract in Orenda Clean® is standardized for curcuminoids, the active compounds responsible for turmeric's most studied benefits, which is an important distinction. Many turmeric products use whole turmeric powder rather than a standardized extract, which delivers inconsistent amounts of the active compounds research actually supports.

Curcuminoids support a healthy inflammation response* and help protect cells from oxidative stress* — two of the most important functions in a daily cleansing formula. Chronic oxidative stress is one of the primary reasons people turn to liver-support and antioxidant supplements, and turmeric's curcuminoids are among the most researched natural compounds for addressing it.*

The turmeric extract in Orenda Clean® also supports digestive comfort,* contributing to the broader digestive support the formula is designed to deliver alongside peppermint, fennel, and aloe vera. Together, these botanicals address digestive wellness from multiple angles, which is consistent with how Orenda Clean® approaches liver and cleansing support overall.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of Aronia Berry in Orenda Clean®?
settings.row_content:
Aronia berries are among the most antioxidant-rich botanicals in the natural world, with higher antioxidant concentrations than blueberries, acai, and most other superfruits commonly found in wellness products. That matters because antioxidants play a direct role in supporting the body's natural defenses against oxidative stress,* which is central to what a daily cleansing formula is designed to do.

The aronia berry powder in Orenda Clean® supports the body's natural cleansing processes* and helps protect cells from oxidative stress.* Research also suggests aronia berries support a healthy inflammation response,* which contributes to overall wellness when the body's natural cleansing processes are working well.*

For a daily cleansing formula, the quality and potency of the antioxidant base matter considerably. Aronia berry is one of the reasons Orenda Clean® is built on a different level than most botanical cleansing supplements on the market.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of aloe vera powder in Orenda Clean®?
settings.row_content:
Aloe vera has been used for digestive support for centuries and is one of the most well-researched botanicals for gut health. While it is widely recognized for topical use, the internal benefits of aloe vera are equally well established, and it is the digestive and cleansing benefits that make it a meaningful addition to Orenda Clean®.*

The aloe vera powder in Orenda Clean® supports gut health and digestive comfort,* helping to soothe the digestive system and reduce occasional bloating.* It also supports the body's natural cleansing processes,* contributing to the overall detox support the formula is designed to deliver.

For a daily detox drink meant to be taken consistently, aloe vera plays an important supporting role, gentle enough for everyday use, well-researched enough to earn its place in a formula built around serious detox support. It works alongside peppermint, fennel, and serrapeptase to address digestive wellness from multiple angles,* which is consistent with how Orenda Clean® approaches cleansing support overall.

settings.heading: What are the benefits of peppermint leaf extract in Orenda Clean®?
settings.row_content:
Peppermint has one of the longest histories of use in herbal medicine, with research consistently supporting its role in digestive comfort and natural cleansing. It is among the most studied botanicals for bloating relief and digestive soothing,* making it a well-earned addition to a daily detox formula rather than simply a flavoring ingredient.

The peppermint leaf extract in Orenda Clean® supports the digestive system,* helping to ease the occasional discomfort that can accompany the body's natural cleansing processes.* It also supports the body's natural cleansing pathways,* contributing to the overall detox story the formula is built around.

For a daily drink taken consistently, peppermint leaf extract does quiet but reliable work, supporting digestive comfort from the first sip while contributing to the broader cleansing support the formula is designed to deliver.*

settings.heading: Benefits of Licorice Root
settings.row_content:
Step into the spotlight, Licorice Root. Now this isn't the sugary treat you're familiar with, but a revered botanical dynamo, venerated for millennia for its remarkable health-supporting characteristics.

Licorice Root is like your wellness routine's secret weapon. This root, teeming with beneficial plant compounds, is recognized for its
soothing influence on the digestive system and for supporting gut health, ensuring you feel your best from the inside out.*

One of the standout attributes of Licorice Root is its cleansing qualities. By aiding in the removal of unwanted substances from our bodies, it supports an internal environment conducive to health and vitality.

Licorice Root is all about balance and comfort. It's nature's way of providing a helping hand when you need it while offering that sense of calm and tranquility we often crave in our busy lives.

So, say 'hello' to Licorice Root, your wellness companion, helping to balance, comfort, and support you on your journey to well-being!

settings.heading: Should I take Orenda Clean® if I am on medication?
settings.row_content: Orenda Clean® was formulated with your well-being in mind. That said, if you are currently under medical care or taking any medications, we recommend consulting with your healthcare provider before adding any new supplement to your routine. Your healthcare provider understands your full health picture and is the right person to make that call with you.
